## Introduction

This document follows the steps of the [intro section](https://e-sensing.github.io/sitsbook/intro_quicktour.html) of sits e-book.


```{r initialize}
base::rm(list = base::ls())
base::invisible(base::gc())

# Location for R functions
code_path <- "R"

base::invisible(
  base::lapply(
    base::list.files(code_path, full.names = TRUE),
    source
  )
)

# Location for data
data_path <- "data"

if (!base::dir.exists(data_path)) {
  base::dir.create(data_path)
}
```

```{r}
samples_matogrosso_mod13q1 <- get_data(
  "samples_matogrosso_mod13q1.parquet",
  data_path
)
```
